attractions: Amber Fort – hilltop fort with mirror-work palace halls
Hawa Mahal – the 'Palace of Winds' façade
City Palace – royal residence and museum

travel.reach: Direct flights and trains from most Indian metros.
travel.tip: Start forts early to avoid the midday heat.

attractions: Fort Kochi – Chinese fishing nets and cafes

travel.reach: Fly into Kochi, then road or boat transfers.
travel.climate: Warm and humid, heavy rain in monsoon
travel.tip: Book the houseboat in advance for peak winter months.

attractions: Baga and Calangute beaches – water sports and nightlife
Basilica of Bom Jesus – UNESCO church

travel.reach: Fly into Dabolim or Mopa; trains reach Madgaon.
travel.climate: Tropical, dry from November to February
travel.tip: Rent a scooter only if you are a confident rider.

attractions: Nubra Valley – sand dunes and double-humped camels
Khardung La – one of the highest motorable passes

travel.reach: Fly to Leh; the Manali–Leh road is open in summer.
travel.climate: Cold desert, thin air at altitude
travel.tip: Rest for 24 to 48 hours on arrival to adjust to altitude.

attractions: Solang Valley – paragliding and snow activities
Old Manali – cafes and riverside walks

travel.reach: Overnight buses from Delhi; fly to Bhuntar and drive.
travel.tip: Check Rohtang permit and road status before you plan.

attractions: Coorg coffee estates – plantation walks and stays
Ooty Nilgiri Mountain Railway – heritage toy train

travel.reach: Fly or train to Mysuru or Coimbatore, then drive.
travel.climate: Cool and misty, rainy in monsoon
travel.tip: Carry a light jacket even in summer evenings.

attractions: Ubud – rice terraces and art markets

travel.reach: Direct and one-stop flights to Denpasar.
travel.climate: Tropical, dry season April to October
travel.tip: Check current visa on arrival rules before you book.

attractions: Eiffel Tower – summit and evening light show
Seine river cruise – city landmarks from the water

travel.reach: Direct flights from Delhi and Mumbai.
travel.tip: A Schengen visa is required; apply well in advance.
